literal: Coming guests every day he who cares for life having suffered falling into ruin is not.
translation: The life of one who cares for arriving guests every day will never suffer and fall into ruin.
modern: நாள்தோறும் வரும் விருந்தினர்களைப் போற்றி உபசரிப்பவனின் வாழ்க்கை, துன்பப்பட்டுப் பாழாவது இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the continuous practice of hospitality. The phrase 'வருவிருந்து வைகலும் ஓம்புவான்' describes a householder who welcomes and cares for guests every single day. The word 'பருவந்து' means experiencing distress or suffering. The couplet assures that such a generous person's domestic life will never face the sorrow of falling into ruin.
